---
title: "06 — Derived environmental variables"
format: html
---

## Goal

Generate only scientifically justified derived variables from validated parent products.

## Candidate derived families

- EKE from currents;
- wind speed from vector winds;
- wind stress and alongshore stress;
- Ekman/upwelling diagnostics;
- oxycline depth/strength from vertical oxygen structure;
- distance to coast from a frozen coastline;
- climatological anomalies only when required by a downstream scientific question.

## Rules

- Record the complete dependency graph.
- Record equations, constants, units, boundary/stencil behavior, and missing-data rules.
- Parent-variable finite support does not automatically imply derived-variable finite support; derived coverage must be audited independently.
- Never fill edge/stencil gaps silently.

## Decision

Every derived family receives its own `GO / REVIEW / STOP` gate.
